title.narrative: ''EU Trade and Competitiveness Programme for Egypt and Jordan''

description.narrative: In the context of enhancing the trade relations with Egypt and Jordan, the Programme aims at bringing local trade-related requirements, industrial standards, technical regulations and animal and plant health measures closer to EU legislation. The Programme will support SMEs in Egypt and Jordan to implement such higher standards through a value chain approach.
